cases.name: Kimberly Ann Funk
cases.about: Her DOB was 2/7/1969 and she was born in Sharon, PA.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE UNSOLVED; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY ID'D HER
cases.narrative: On 2/1/1991, her body was found in a swampy area of Ward Bayou in Vancleave, MS. Her body was believed to have been there for up to three years before it was found, but her brother said she went missing in 1990 and investigators found she arrived in Mississippi from Houston between April and June 1990.
